none.$description: Square corners, for elements flush with an edge, such as full-width banners and table cells.

xs.$description: Barely rounded corners for small elements such as checkboxes and inline code.

sm.$description: Corners for small components: badges, tags, and tooltips.

md.$description: Default corners for controls: buttons, inputs, and selects.

lg.$description: Corners for containers: cards, popovers, and menus.

xl.$description: Corners for large containers such as modals and sheets.

full.$description: Fully rounded ends, for pills, avatars, and circular buttons.

thin.$description: Default border width for dividers, inputs, and cards.

thick.$description: Emphasized borders, such as an underline indicator or a strong divider.

thicker.$description: The heaviest line, for accent bars such as the edge of a callout.

width.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring. Use with border/focus as the color.

offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring, so the ring stays distinct from the element's fill and border.
